attchmntText: Manaksia Steels Limited has informed the Exchange about Key Financial Highlights on the Un-audited Financial Results for the Q2 FY 2027
voiceSummary: Manaksia Steels Limited filed key financial highlights for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. Standalone total income for Q2 FY 27 was 395.39 crore rupees, up 61.55 percent year on year. Standalone profit after tax was 23.52 crore rupees, a 486.74 percent increase. Earnings per share stood at 3.59 rupees. For the half year, standalone total income was 701.27 crore rupees. Profit after tax was 45.90 crore rupees. The Board approved a proposed 800 crore rupee investment in speciality steel at the Haldia facility. The company expects this investment to qualify for incentives under the West Bengal Investment Promotion Policy 2026 announced on 5th November 2026. The company is awaiting detailed policy guidelines to submit a Certificate of Intent. Nigerian subsidiary Federated Steel Mills Ltd reported 38 percent revenue growth.

attchmntText: Manaksia Steels Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Manaksia Steels Limited has approved the Un-audited Financial Results for the quarter and half-year ended 30th September, 2026. The Board of Directors held its meeting on 14th November, 2026, from 01:00 P.M. to 02:50 P.M. The approval covers both Standalone and Consolidated financial results. A Limited Review Report for the same period is also enclosed with the disclosure. This announcement serves as compliance with Regulation 30 and 33(1) read with Para A of Part A of Schedule III of the SEBI Listing Regulations, 2015. The company has submitted the financial results and the review report to the stock exchanges. The document was signed by Ajay Sharma, the Company Secretary, on behalf of Manaksia Steels Limited.
